notes.title: 2025 Updates
notes.content:
Happy June!


I just wanted to drop a quick update on Alpine Lake progress this year! There are so many fun additions to the game that I'm very excited to share. Steady progress is being made every day and your patience for the game is much appreciated!


Skiing
Did you know that near town is actually an old ski resort that needs your help? After a few simple repairs you'll be able to access this new unique skiing mini-game!


Alpine Regional Trail
In the demo there were about 10 animals you could photograph. The amount of animals has increased to 40! Depending on the season, the weather, and where you are, certain animals will make an appearance. Capturing their photos will be very important for the future of the forest!



In addition to the animals, many foraged resources were added to make unique meals and drinks for your guests!



Currently work is being done to expand to the town to allow guests to decide to move in! More updates on that later.



I'm very excited to bring Alpine Lake to everyone very soon. Thanks for hanging in there :)



-Andrew
